TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1823-25 West 22 Place
From RS-3 to RT-4

The Property
The subject property is situated in a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District on the south side of West 22nd

Place. It is located in a Transit Served Location approximately 1,600 feet from the Damen Pink Line CTA station exit.

The property is one lot comprised of two parcels (Lot 58 and Lot 59). Lot 38 is improved with a 2.5 story multi-unit
residential building (approx. 27'-4" height) with two residential units and a detached rear two car garage. Lot 59 is
improved with a two car garage at the rear of the property.

The Project
Nicholas Ludmer (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to allow a third residential unit in the basement, The

existing structures will remain and main building height will remain. Parking will remain and no additional parking will be
added.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to a RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed for the attached plans, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a
Type-1 application under section 17-13-0300(D) including: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce
the front yard setback required under section 17-2-0305 to zero; 2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to
reduce the east side yard setback required under sections 17-2-0309-A from minimum 2.0° to 0.2”; 3) an optional variation
under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the west side yard setback required under sections 17-2-0309-A from minimum 2.0°
to 1.617; 4) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required combined side yard setback under
section 17-2-0309-A from 5.0’ to 1.81’; 5) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear yard
setback under section 17-2-0306-C to zero; and 6) an optional variation under sections 17-13-1003-K and 17-13-1101-A to
reduce the rear yard open space required under section 17-2-0307 to zero.

‘The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 4,800 square feet

FAR: 0.84

Floor Area: 4,011 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 3

MLA Density: 1,600 square feet

Height: 27'-4" (existing)

Automobile Parking: 4 (existing)

Rear Yard Open Space: zero* (existing)

Setbacks (existing): Front (North/22™ Pl): —_zero*
East: 0.2 feet*
West: 1.61 feet*
Rear (South): zero*

A set of plans is attached.

* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
